title: Left alone at 11: figure on the roof and a fleeing policeman

tellings.quote: Seconds later he comes running down yelling, "There's no one there. There's no one there."

plain: In 1956, when he was 11 and home alone in Terrell Hills, a suburb of San Antonio, Texas, the writer Whitley Strieber, who says he has met nonhuman beings, says a figure was seen on the roof of the house. He says a policeman climbed up to look and seconds later came running down shouting, "There's no one there. There's no one there." Strieber tells it as one of the strange events of his own childhood.
